summary: Frontend-only regression + new Nutrition section testing on live URL. Verified nutrition-section presence (id='nutricion'), title, 4 pillar cards, CTA (data-testid='nutrition-cta-button') scrolls to #contacto, contact-objective-select includes 'Nutrición' among the 6 expected options (HYROX, DEKA, Crosstraining, Bodybuilding, Nutrición, Otro), submitting the form with Nutrición selected opens https://wa.me/34694463184?text=... containing name, email, message and 'Objetivo:* Nutrición' (bold-wrapped) in the payload. Scroll-reveal animations transition all nutrition-section [data-reveal] elements from opacity 0 to 1 upon entering the viewport (no stuck-at-0 elements).
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsApp payload uses '*Objetivo:*' (Markdown bold) which decodes as '*Objetivo:* Nutrición'. The original spec text 'Objetivo: Nutrición' is present with the added bold asterisks; if the spec requires the plain form, note that the asterisks are intentional WhatsApp formatting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nutrition section fully verified. Contact form uses native <select> (not shadcn) — use page.select_option, not role=option clicks. Scroll-reveal elements start at opacity 0 and transition to 1 via IntersectionObserver; must scroll into view to verify.
